en: The postcard features five monochrome photographs of various seaside and architectural scenes, arranged artistically around ornate divider graphics. The images show a pier-like structure on water, bathing houses, a tree-lined street or promenade, and a large wooden building. The prominent German text reads 'Gruss aus Seebad Pernau', indicating it is a greeting from a seaside spa/town named Pernau. There is also a coat of arms with a crown and a cross in the upper left corner.
